### [`fireball_active`](../../../src/fireball_text_score_vars.asm#L8) `$432E-$432F`

*variable*

Fireball variables of room 18 (wizard), 2 entries each (index 0 = sprite 6, index 1 = sprite 7). fireball_active: 0 = no fireball, 1 = falling. launch_fireball0/launch_fireball1 set it; update_fireballs clears it when the fireball Y reaches $E0.

fireball_x: X position in 2-pixel units (written doubled to SP6X/SP7X, carry into MSIGX). update_fireballs moves it toward Bruce's X (actor_x) by 3 steps per pass while fireball_y < $A8, by 2 steps lower down. Launch X: $50 (fireball 0) and $5E (fireball 1).

<a id="text_line_top_lo"></a>
### [`text_line_top_lo`](../../../src/fireball_text_score_vars.asm#L33) `$4338-$434B`

*variable*

Text line address tables, 20 entries each (14 used, index = text line 0-13). reset_play_state calls build_screen_row_tables with game_screen - 40 ($8BD8): line n top row = $8BD8 + 80*n, bottom row = top + 40. Then reset_play_state sets the top row of line 0 to game_screen and the bottom rows of lines 0 and 1 to io1_dummy (unused I/O area: writes there are lost), so the separator row 2 stays intact. Game screen: line 0 = row 0, line 1 = row 1 (status line), line n >= 2 = rows 2n-1 (top) and 2n (bottom). set_text_row_pointers loads entry X into row_ptr_top and row_ptr_bottom; while text_single_height is nonzero it points row_ptr_bottom at io1_dummy too (single-height text). Entries 14-19 are not used; the image bytes are leftovers of the build.

<a id="top_score"></a>
### [`top_score`](../../../src/fireball_text_score_vars.asm#L56) `$4388-$438A`

*variable*

TOP score: 24-bit binary, most significant byte first. update_high_score compares it byte by byte with score and, when the score is higher, update_high_score_store copies the 4 bytes score..score+3 here: a new top score also overwrites bonus_fall_first_score+0 with zero page $44 (raster_split_index). show_high_score converts it to BCD for the status line.

- **Read by:** [`update_high_score`](score.md#update_high_score) [`$31A6`](../../../src/score.asm#L92), [`update_high_score`](score.md#update_high_score) [`$31A6`](../../../src/score.asm#L92) (+1), [`show_high_score`](score.md#show_high_score) [`$31C4`](../../../src/score.asm#L115) (+2)

<a id="bonus_fall_first_score"></a>
### [`bonus_fall_first_score`](../../../src/fireball_text_score_vars.asm#L62) `$438B-$438D`

*data*

Score of the first bonus fall: 24-bit binary $009C40 = 40000. init_game_copy_scores copies it to bonus_fall_next_score and bonus_fall_next_score_other at a game start. update_high_score_store overwrites the first byte with raster_split_index whenever a new top score is stored: in run d1-top the value was 2 at all 7 stores, so after a game with a new top score the first bonus fall moves to $029C40 = 171072.

- **Read by:** [`init_game_variables`](game_setup.md#init_game_variables) [`$0FCB`](../../../src/game_setup.asm#L69) (+1), [`init_game_variables`](game_setup.md#init_game_variables) [`$0FCB`](../../../src/game_setup.asm#L69) (+2), [`show_high_score`](score.md#show_high_score) [`$31C4`](../../../src/score.asm#L115)
